title: NZ First list ranks newcomers above sitting MPs
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
NZ First list ranks newcomers above sitting MPs

New Zealand First has unveiled its candidate list, giving high placements to former MPs Alfred Ngaro, Michael Laws and Harete Hipango-Brownlie.

Actual Article Body:
RNZ / News / Politics

Link: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9._Q.VKhexyL5oal5uCV3AUQmI1EOdryHi3hh73RdibV20lY/politics/1780805%2Fnz-first-list-ranks-newcomers-above-sitting-mps

New Zealand First has unveiled its candidate list, giving high placements to former MPs Alfred Ngaro, Michael Laws and Harete Hipango-Brownlie.

Former Financial Markets Authority chair Craig Stobo and former All Blacks captain Taine Randell are also ranked high - beating out several current MPs including Jenny Marcroft, Andy Foster, Dr David Wilson and Jamie Arbuckle.

Former Buller mayor Jamie Cleine is at 14th, and former defence minister and Carterton mayor Ron Mark is at 16th.

With the latest RNZ-Reid Research poll putting support for the party at 10.6 percent, the party would get 13 MPs into Parliament.

1. Rt Hon Winston Peters, List only

2. Hon Shane Jones, Northland

3. Hon Casey Costello, Port Waikato

4. Hon Mark Patterson, Taieri

5. Hon Alfred Ngaro, Glendene

6. Michael Laws, Waitaki

7. Harete Hipango-Brownlie, Whanganui

8. Craig Stobo, Botany

9. Taine Randell, Tukituki

10. Jenny Marcroft, Kaipara-ki-Mahurangi

11. Andy Foster, Remutaka

12. Dr David Wilson, Henderson

13. Jamie Arbuckle, Kaikōura

14. Jamie Cleine, West Coast-Tasman

15. Tracey Coxhead, Mt Maunganui

16. Hon Ron Mark, Wairarapa

17. Jason Herrick, Southland

18. Esther Tofilau-Tevaga, Manurewa

19. Penny Gaylor, Kāpiti

20. Elliot Ikilei, Takanini

21. Vicky Hau, Māngere

22. Bernadette Soares, Upper Harbour

23. Robert Cookson, Waikato

24. Mark Arneil, Christchurch Central

25. Lee Smith, Taranaki-King Country
